label: Kids
description: Playful activities that help children name feelings and talk about worries, friends and family changes.

label: Teens
description: Scenario and check-in activities on pressure, friendships, mood, online life and identity.

label: Adults
description: Check-ins and exercises on stress, mood, sleep, relationships and life pressures, with optional packs for men and for women.

label: Older adults
description: Gentle, large-text activities on loneliness, loss, sleep, health worries and purpose in later life.
